_help: Act 7, McKenna's (one action): McKenna's word (the Americans' hired guns), and Freddie Mallory, back in town, if you kept his secret (freddie_note, not freddie_betrayed): he knows the fence, so the plan (thieves_plan_known). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: mckenna
start.line: Half my regulars are praying and the other half are drinking like it's the last night on earth. Maybe it is.

f_hello.speaker: freddie
f_hello.line: Old man! Don't hit me. I came back from Alex because there's money in a panic, and because I owe you. I know who's fencing your thieves' run.

fp_americans.speaker: freddie
fp_americans.line: The Yanks have a steamer, the Star of Luxor. Thursday's tide. Call it a down payment on what I owe.

fp_germans.speaker: freddie
fp_germans.line: The Germans are on the Alexandria night express with a sealed van. Call it a down payment.

fp_italians.speaker: freddie
fp_italians.line: Bellini's trucks go out on the coast road once he greases a permit. Call it a down payment.

r_am.speaker: mckenna
r_am.line: Callahan's been in, buying guns, not drinks. Whatever the Yanks are guarding, they mean to fight for it.
